title: Struct#== and #eql? keep the member storage across a callback whose initialize_copy replaces it
live_proof: upstream fixed it in 7c5915799 (7c59157994d01510a8395d33b9f974d4888cdc94) (2026-08-12), which is in master and postdates the 4.0.0-rc2 pin (2026-03-12); the pin's tree has no such fix. Host ASan at the pin: heap-use-after-free (with MRB_HEAP_PAGE_SIZE=1: heap-use-after-free); the same case on master: no report
fidelity: the trigger is the Ruby test upstream added with its fix, extracted onto a self-contained harness that collects failures instead of aborting, so one script yields one verdict. It is upstream's own reproduction, not a reduction of ours; what it does NOT establish is which arm ought to catch it

sysalloc-none.oracle: completes, and the harness reports a wrong answer rather than a fault -- a differential, not a detection: ["Struct#== and #eql? with a member that replaces the storage", "NOT_FALSE", "true"]
